list: Official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-20 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (names, descriptions, grades and PSN counts agree). Grades: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden on PlayStation. No online trophies.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. Expect roughly 200 hours in total (PowerPyx estimate). No online trophy and no DLC is needed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned by finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed: play the story and it pops at the end of the mission. This is the first trophy most players earn (over 90% of tracked players hold it).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing this guide flags as possibly missable: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). There is no mission replay in GTA 6, so finish each chapter's optional content before moving on.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. The last meditation spot only opens once Jason and Lucia are both playable, which happens after Chapter 2, so from here on you can meditate at the spots you find. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals with the binoculars as you travel: the 100% checklist later asks for 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Nothing special to prepare: keep playing the main missions and take the optional missions (black icons with pink letters) when they appear, since some disappear after a while. They do not affect trophies, but they feed the stranger strands and character quests later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Before you leave this chapter, check the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' — it is the setup Maximum Withdrawal needs, so do it while it is offered rather than assuming it waits.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission (Chapter 5 in some listings). Free-roam continues after the credits, so the story ending is the start of the cleanup phase, not the end of the run. Save manually at the start and end of every chapter: missions cannot be replayed, and cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep cheats off for the whole run.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, with no extra requirement. If you are tracking the story in order, this is one of the early mission trophies; play it when the game offers it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission The Cartel Heist. A straight completion trophy: finish the heist and it pops. Heists feed the robbery totals that later trophies (Maximum Withdrawal, Dime on the Dollar) build on, so the money and marked bills you pick up here are not wasted.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission Child's Play. No side objective is needed; completing the mission is the whole requirement. Keep an eye on the optional missions around it, since some expire while the story moves on.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission Headliners. It is a completion trophy only: reach the end of the mission and it unlocks. There is no medal or rank requirement on any story mission in GTA 6.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. While you are at VCIA, remember the separate free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can (an unscheduled departure from the airport) — it is a different trophy from this mission, and it can be done in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission Operation Savage Glory. Complete the operation and the trophy pops. This is the last of the six named-mission story trophies; after it, the remaining story trophies are the chapter finales and the character quest finales.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the gold for 100% completion. The checklist itself appears in Progress, then Stats, after the story, but progress made earlier still counts. The thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion — and most of it is finished by doing the other trophies: the checklist asks for 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 30 races won, 15 card sets, 15 meditation spots and 8 bank vaults, which are all above the matching trophy targets, so plan on the checklist, not on the trophies, being the long grind (about 100 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Silver for pulling off 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count, and flying under bridges is reported as the quickest kind. Stunts also feed the 100% checklist, which wants 300, so keep doing them past this trophy — the same habit covers both numbers. The counter is the PSN-tracked one (0/250).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. The game tracks the count (0/9), so open Progress, then Stats, and see which types are still at zero — the missing ones are the ones to try. Any one try of each type counts; you do not need to win, finish first, or be good at any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSN tracks 0/42). The 100% checklist also asks for all 42, so this is one trophy that is exactly the checklist item. Take one weapon class at a time and learn its range before chasing gold; the ranges are a fixed set, so the same practice carries across every challenge.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (PowerPyx counts 14 locations and 42 races). You only need one win per location, not every race, so a single clean win at each spot is enough. Learn the course on a slow first run, then race it for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same race 20 times. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 30, so keep racing past this trophy with new courses. Mix race types (road, off-road, drone) so the wins also feed the activity and vehicle totals.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also ticks one of the 9 for Master of None. Go for it when Cal offers the challenge rather than free-fishing alone: the trophy needs the head-to-head challenge, not just a catch.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, any game, any arcade. Pick the shortest game on offer and play it to its end — completion, not a high score, is the requirement. Arcades are also an activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Character-quest trophy: finish Andy's last mission. Andy's chain is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia when it is offered. Quest givers tied to trophies return after the story, so if you miss a step during the chapters you can pick the chain up again in free-roam — but start it when it first unlocks to be safe.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Character-quest trophy: finish Kenton's last mission. Work through Kenton's chain when his missions appear; like the other character finales, it is a completion trophy with no extra objective. The five character-final trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) all sit in the story stage of the roadmap.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Character-quest trophy: finish Billy's last mission. Follow Billy's chain to its end. Nothing about the trophy needs a specific choice or a perfect run — finishing the final mission is the whole unlock.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for finishing 8 stranger mission strands (PSN tracks 0/8). Start each strand when it unlocks: one guide notes the stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave them all for after the credits. The strands are spread across Leonida, so take them as you travel for other trophies and let the count build.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Character-quest trophy: finish Randy's last mission. Play Randy's chain through to its final mission. As with the other character finales, the trophy is for completion only, and the quest giver comes back after the story if you left the chain unfinished.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Character-quest trophy: finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's chain is Jason-only, so play it as Jason. This is the last of the five character-final trophies; with it done, the story stage of the roadmap is essentially complete except the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations (PSN tracks 0/18; GTABase counts 18 spots). This is the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable, and the warning is specific: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth — talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether it counts toward the 18, so do it while you can. The last spot only opens once Jason and Lucia are both playable, after Chapter 2. Note the mismatch: the 100% checklist asks for only 15 spots, so the trophy and the checklist count different things.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the first meditation (Lucia, balcony at Jason's house, Chapter 1) is reported gone after Chapter 1. Do it during Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal is still unconfirmed in the guides, so treat this as a quest to follow, not a target to hunt blind: take Bret's missions when they appear and let the quest point at the animal. Bret's chain is Jason-only. The animal-study habit from the 100% checklist (100 of 255 animals through the binoculars) helps here too, since you learn the wildlife while you work.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida, so pick them up as you travel rather than hunting them all at the end. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, far above this trophy's 3, so the card hunt continues long past this pop — treat 3 sets as the start, not the finish.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Silver for using WAiNK at 100 locations (PSN tracks 0/100). WAiNK is the in-game phone's scanning/sharing app: point it at things worth sharing as you travel and the count climbs. It doubles as the vehicle-discovery method for Whip It Good — one guide reports scanning 100 different vehicles with WAiNK without driving them, so scan traffic near busy roads and let both trophies progress together. The 100% checklist also asks for 100, so this number is the final one.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy's 50 is a waypoint on the way to 70 — keep going after it pops. Challenges overlap with nearly every other trophy (stunts, races, robberies, collectibles), so most of the 50 arrive while you play for other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then lose it and escape the heat zone. One guide suggests a train tunnel north of Ambrosia for breaking line of sight, and notes bank vault robberies often trigger the wanted level in the first place — so this pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal. Stay with your partner until the stars clear: the escape only counts with them beside you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. The jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together, which makes the chain easy to keep up. One guide adds a practical tip: rob a fourth shop if the trophy does not pop after the third. Plan the route first, then run the three (or four) robberies without stopping.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles (PSN tracks 0/100). Scanning with WAiNK counts without driving, so scan traffic near busy roads and the number climbs fast. This is the discovery half of the vehicle work: the 100% checklist later wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so the habit you build here covers the bigger number too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Fill the Focus meter first, then spend it where enemies are grouped. One guide reports gang members count while cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to, so pick a gang fight for the attempt — an assault rifle is the suggested tool. If the meter runs out at 4, refill and try again; the trophy only needs one clean run of 5.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA (the airport) in an unscheduled way. One guide's reading: steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away from the airport. It is a free-roam trophy, not tied to the VCIA Takedown mission, so do it after the story when you can take your time at the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the tank, and the trophy is about doing something with one. One guide's reading: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. Go in with a plan for the wanted level that follows — stealing military hardware brings heat, so pick your exit before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. One guide's reported method: use the Snap Gun on the store's back door, find the safe code, and empty the safe without being spotted. Patience is the whole trick — if a guard or camera catches you, leave and reset rather than fighting through it, since detection voids the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping (PSN tracks 0/5; the 100% checklist wants 8). It needs the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...', then following a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the way out and plan a fast bike for the escape. Vault robberies also trigger the wanted level Hot Together needs, so the two trophies pair well.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so watch one, hit it when it stops, and get clear before the response arrives. Unlike the bank vaults, this needs no mission setup — it is a free-roam robbery you can attempt whenever you spot a truck.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog over every part of Leonida (PSN tracks 0/52 areas). Flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest way to reveal them. Do this alongside the vehicle scanning and the WAiNK locations: one trip across the state can feed The Goodtime State, Whip It Good and You WAiNKer! at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs (PSN tracks 0/9). Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you hit it, so every robbery counts toward a different gang — repeating the same gang's operation wastes the run. This is a checklist-style trophy: nine distinct targets, one each.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The steps for this one are still unconfirmed in the guides (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known), so the honest advice is: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or vendor with a view of the water, and order a cocktail there. If the first spot does not pop it, try another beachfront bar — the requirement is the drink plus the view, not a specific venue the guides have pinned down yet.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style. The exact steps are still unconfirmed (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); one guide suggests crashing a car out through a showroom window. Drive a car into a showroom, then drive it back out through the glass — the 'classic style' is the smash, not a quiet exit. Expect a wanted level and a repair bill.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the follow-through is the bowling action itself. Go to the alley, start a game and finish it. The wording is vague in the official description, so treat a full game of bowling at that alley as the requirement; it pairs naturally with Ten Pin, the other bowling trophy, so do both in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership trophy whose official description gives almost nothing away. One guide's reading: max out Strength for both characters. Train Strength with both Jason and Lucia until each is maxed — gym work and the activities that build it — and the trophy should follow the second character's max. Labelled as a reported reading, not a confirmed step, until more players verify it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile — one guide reports the PSN-tracked count is 500 actions. Play the story making choices (the profile shifts with what you do, for better or worse), and the count builds across the whole run. One warning matters here: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so read up on the Criminal Profile before going on a rampage that could lock your character's standing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The steps for this one are still unconfirmed in the guides (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known), so the honest read is in the name: fail at something, then succeed at it the second time. It is most likely tied to an activity or challenge with a retry — if you fail a challenge or event, retry it at once rather than moving on, and see if the second attempt pops it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange somewhere in Leonida. The steps are still unconfirmed (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); one guide reads it as a strange event out in the world. The practical advice is to explore widely and pay attention to odd encounters — roadside scenes, strange characters, unusual events — rather than hunting one spot the guides have not pinned down. It will most likely come to you while doing The Goodtime State's exploration.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. The steps are still unconfirmed (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known), but the name says the shape of it: a drive-by using a melee weapon, with the target bowled over. Try it at the bowling alley area — it pairs with Let's Go Bowling — and use a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. If it does not pop, vary the weapon and the target.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (PSN tracks 0/250000). Marked Bills come from the robberies, so this total builds up during the 100% robbery work — one guide notes a single fence pays the most, so use the best-paying contact you have. It is a slow earner by design: keep laundering after every robbery instead of letting the bills pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (PSN tracks 0/100000). Shops, garages, clothes, weapons and food all count toward the same total, so normal play spends a good part of it — and the 8 garages for Little Boxes (about $160,000 in all) cover the whole amount on their own. If you are short at the end, buy ammo and supplies you will use anyway rather than wasting money.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties (PSN tracks 0/8). They are listed in the Vice City Real Estate app and cost about $160,000 in all. The 4 story garages do not count, so only the 8 bought ones matter — check the app's list against what you own and buy the missing ones. The same spending also finishes Treat Yo Self.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (PSN tracks 0/10). Find vehicles around Leonida, then register them through the app — discovery plus registration, not ownership. It pairs with Whip It Good's scanning: scan a vehicle with WAiNK first, then register it, and the same car feeds both trophies.
trophies.name: On the Spot

verified.note: Names, descriptions, grades and PSN counts verified against Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-20; roadmap and method facts cite PowerPyx and CryptoGames (summarising GTABase and PowerPyx). Five trophies are still unconfirmed in the published guides and are marked as such in their guides.
